description: LiNa₂(NH₂)₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to four N and four H atoms. There are two shorter (2.51 Å) and two longer (2.55 Å) Na-N bond lengths. There are two shorter (2.54 Å) and two longer (2.62 Å) Na-H bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to four equivalent N atoms. All Na-N bond lengths are 2.56 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 14-coordinate geometry to six N and eight H atoms. There are two shorter (2.79 Å) and four longer (2.82 Å) Na-N bond lengths. There are four shorter (2.62 Å) and four longer (2.73 Å) Na-H bond lengths. Li is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three N atoms. There is one shorter (2.00 Å) and two longer (2.06 Å) Li-N bond lengths. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to three Na, one Li, and two H atoms. Both N-H bond lengths are 1.03 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and two equivalent H atoms. Both N-H bond lengths are 1.03 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one N atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one N atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two Na and one N atom.
